style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: big COBALT-BLUE vest, round glasses, red party cone, yellow backpack with red bow 65. Calm, serious. Never flies.
second_characters: ONE mole boss, grey suit, white hanky, in the open top window. ONE beaver digger, ORANGE vest. ONE rabbit colleague in a lower window.
props: Backpack, pink paper cocktail umbrella: goose's. White gold-rim wall clocks: mole's, a stack on his sill. Shovel: beaver's. Glass: rabbit's.
environment: TURQUOISE glass office tower, flag garland on the open 40th-floor window. Below: grey tile courtyard, EMERALD lawn with rows of small round discs.
lighting: Bright noon sun; warm key on the goose's face, orange rim left, magenta rim right. Blue vest, red cone, yellow backpack vivid in every shot, close-ups too.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice 0.6-7.0 s, beak free while speaking; no speech after 7.0 s

timeline.a: From the first frame: goose falls head-first down the glass tower, wings press the backpack; far above the mole waves his hanky, a clock under his arm; far below rows of small discs.
timeline.c: plunges head-first under him, looking up

timeline.a: Goose yanks the backpack ring, beak free; a tiny pink cocktail umbrella pops out and jerks him upright; wings flick open and press back; his left wing holds it overhead, he spins like a top.
timeline.c: tumbles round his spin, courtyard discs swinging below, dives into the umbrella, close-up

timeline.a: Goose spins down past a lower window, beak free, umbrella overhead; the rabbit raises his glass.
timeline.c: flies through the window, rabbit's glass in foreground

timeline.a: Goose's feet hit the tiles: tiles fan up, earth fountains, he sinks neck-deep in a hole, beak free.
timeline.c: top-down, drops into the earth fountain, bounces up

timeline.a: Earth rains on him; glasses slip to his beak tip; his right wingtip pushes them up, left wing keeps the umbrella up, beak free.
timeline.c: hurls itself at his glasses, close-up

timeline.a: Beaver skids to the hole edge, looks in, lowers his shovel to the tiles; goose plants the umbrella by his head like a beach umbrella, beak free; a round shadow grows over them.
timeline.c: arcs low round the hole, shovel in foreground

timeline.a: Mole opens his paws: a wall clock falls spinning and slams face up onto the hole, driving the goose under; earth splashes out round it.
timeline.c: drops with the spinning clock, slams in on its face, close-up

timeline.a: Beaver slaps the clock rim twice with his shovel; the pink umbrella sticks up beside it like a grave flower.
timeline.c: whips round low to the shovel

timeline.a: From high above: rows of identical clocks face up, each with a pink umbrella. Last frame: in the top window the mole lifts the next clock from the stack.
timeline.c: rockets back up to the window, close-up on the mole's clock

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, letters, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, muted colors, night, dark scene, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, humans
